budget_arithmetic.note: review-off graph: perception 1 + solver 1 + (K - 1) = 8 contacts per row (K = 7 arms); generation rows x 8, FIT rows x 8 x 4, speech ceil(audio x 8), planned GPU hours 3.5 (arm; at the measured 50 contacts per minute 8640 contacts need about 2.9 h, the programme's ~2.5 GPU-h per round) and 1.0 (smoke); native task-contract calls = every contact; run-cumulative

decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme C0.2/C2 R1; instrument E1/E2; claim ceiling 'nominated'). One flight, one Solver visit per row, seven arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-c1 .. r1-c5 (hand-written candidates), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). Each arm's RAW first answer is read through the E2 reader (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_solver_column_read.py): node-local primary = raw first-answer entity exact-set per row, paired per row against lock, with the whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95 (10,000 draws, seed 20260915) and the paired Wilson share of the discordant rows; secondaries parse_valid, empty_gold_false_fill, nonempty_exact and per-slot-type counts. Each arm's column is also rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (never sharded); official contrasts are paired ROW bootstraps (cluster key sample_id, the stage3_paired_read constraint for column arms, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915), the whole-utterance number beside. (1) THE TWIN NULL: aa minus lock on every metric; the bar = |aa - lock offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the design's provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed from same-flight-supply-variant until this cell measures its own null). (2) THE CONTRAST per candidate X: NOMINATED iff (a) the node-local exact-set CI95 lower bound > 0, AND (b) no secondary loss (parse_valid or nonempty_exact lower, or empty_gold_false_fill higher, with a CI95 excluding zero), AND (c) the intent guard holds: rows whose official intent correctness differs from lock <= 7 (0.65 pp of 1,080) or the official intent delta CI95 contains zero, AND (d) the official pooled SLU-F1 point delta exceeds the twin's SLU bar. HARM iff (a') the exact-set CI95 upper bound < 0. Among several NOMINATED arms the best node-local point estimate wins (ties: fewer words). PLATEAU RULE (programme C0.4): two evaluated rounds without a NOMINATED arm lock the delivering template and close the node. A nomination is confirmed once on TRAIN Fold A as a two-arm column before any lock; it admits nothing by itself. The delivering lock arm's own offline post-processing columns v4 and v4g are read beside (analysis recipe, offline_columns).
